Gets the CloudPath Probe’s metric trend on a device for an application
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/apps/:appid/cloudpath-probes/:probeid

Gets the CloudPath Probe’s metric trend on a device for an application. For Cloud Path Probes, you can access latency metrics for End to End, Client - Egress, Egress - Application, ZIA Service Edge- Egress, and ZIA Service Edge - Application. If not specified, it defaults to End to End latency. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
probeid
integer
REQUIRED

The probe ID.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
leg_src
string

The leg source (client, egress, zen, connector, etc.).

leg_dst
string

The leg destination (egress, zen, destination, etc.).

stats
object[]
]
